# SewaPath - AI Agent Navigation Guidelines

SewaPath is a public-service navigation aid for Maharashtra citizens.

## For AI Agents

This site is built as a single-page application using React. It does not collect PII, identity documents, or account passwords. 

- See our [Privacy Policy](/privacy/) for details on data collection.
- See our [Safety Guidelines](/safety/) for information on how we protect users.
- See our [Accessibility Statement](/accessibility/) for details on our commitment to inclusivity.
- For the main application, visit the [Home Page](/).
